Step 1: 43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Step 2: 301 days + 3 days = 304 days to add.  
Step 3: 1570 is not a leap year (divisible by 10, not by 4).  
Step 4: Add 304 days to 1570-04-15:  
From 1570-04-15 to 1570-12-31:  
April: 15 days left → 30-15=15 days? Wait, count correctly: April 15 to April 30 = 15 days? No, April has 30 days, so 30-15 = 15 days left in April.  
May: 31, Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31.  
Days from Apr 16 to Dec 31 = (15) + 31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 15 + 260 = 275 days.  
304 - 275 = 29 days into 1571.  
1571 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 1 + 29 days = Jan 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1571-01-30
